purpose: Close CC-WP-01 by freezing the exact current ClayCode semantic implementation baseline. Remaining parser/compiler/runtime gaps are executable implementation counterexamples and may not silently mutate semantics.
semantic_authority_order: typed canonical IR meaning defined by frozen semantic_core + dialect_contract
surface syntax/grammar only after deterministic binding into typed canonical IR

semantic_change_law.allowed_only_if: A production compiler/application/FRANK executable counterexample proves the frozen contract cannot express or lower required behavior.
semantic_change_law.required_response: Preserve failing fixture, propose the smallest falsifiable semantic delta, run regression/differential tests, and retain rollback/supersession provenance.

implementation_counterexamples.observation: The published G9 research grammar contains call expressions but no general reusable function-definition production.
implementation_counterexamples.disposition: Production frontend must materialize deterministic typed definition/signature binding or demonstrate equivalent frozen semantics; this does not justify a FRANK-specific primitive.

implementation_counterexamples.observation: Baseline D LALR grammar has known keyword/newline parser-table conflicts.
implementation_counterexamples.disposition: Use D_LALR_GRAMMAR_REPAIR_CANDIDATE_V4.lark plus strict/full-corpus/baseline-differential receipts. Repair may tighten ambiguous keyword-as-identifier surfaces but may not silently change admitted corpus meaning.

implementation_counterexamples.observation: Deterministic typed canonical IR serialization/semantic-hash roundtrip is not yet admitted as production receipt.
implementation_counterexamples.disposition: Close under CC-WP-02/03 without changing frozen semantics unless an executable counterexample forces a minimal delta.

explicit_non_admissions: proxy experiment output as production compiler evidence
host ambient authority as ClayCode authority
Android/mobile/edge portability as Frank v0.1 BASE requirement
